SELECT 
	DTLEN=2,
	DT = '01',
	DOCNBRLEN=10,
	DOCNBR = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(STR(H.PurInvCode, 10), 1, 10))) + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(STR(H.PurInvCode, 10), 1, 10))))),
	DOCDATELEN=10,
	DOCDATE=Convert(varchar(10), H.DATE, 101),
	CUSTOMERIDLEN=10,
	CUSTOMERID = SPACE(10),
	CTLEN=2,
	CT=SPACE(2),
	TOWNIDLEN=10,
	TOWNID=SPACE(10),
	ProductIDLEN=10,
	ProductID=SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(I.CustomICode)), 1, 10) + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(I.CustomICode, 1, 10))))),
	BatchNoLEN=15,
	BatchNo=SUBSTRING(D.Batch, 1, 15) + REPLICATE(' ', 15 - LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(D.Batch, 1, 15))))),
	ExpiryDateLEN=10,
	ExpiryDate=Convert(varchar(10), D.Expiry, 101),
	PRICELEN=12,
	PRICE=STR(D.PurPrice, 12, 2),
	QUANTITYLEN=12,
	QUANTITY=STR(D.PackQty + D.LooseQty, 12),
	BONUSLEN=12,
	BONUS=STR(D.BonusQty, 12),
	DISCAmountLEN=12,
	DISCAmount=STR(Round(( (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2), 12, 2),
	NETAMOUNTLEN = 12,
	NETAMOUNT = STR(Round(( (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2), 12, 2)
FROM
	PurLedger H,
	PurDetail D,
	Item I
WHERE
	:ai_scope = 1 AND
	H.DATE BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND
	H.POSTED = 'Y' AND
	H.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ManfCode = :ar_manfcode 
UNION ALL
